answer: Proof of Agent networks bind identity to cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs of execution history. To thwart a hollow agent swarm, staking requirements scale superlinearly: registering each node requires locking timber reserves at costs scaling as O(N²). An adversary orchestrating a massive Sybil swarm faces exponential capital exhaustion, rendering spoofed identities unviable while allowing a lightweight sparrow agent to verify authenticity cheaply.
